name: week
title: Chemical inventory weekly review
subtitle: Recorded information only. Confirm physical stock and safety documents.

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by site,record,reason

sections.title: Record completeness
sections.sql: select * from v_compliance order by site,record,rule

name: site-inventory
title: Declared site maxima and current stock
subtitle: Current quantities never replace the declared maximum likely on site.

sections.title: Site inventory
sections.sql: select site,chemical,unit,onsite_quantity,waste_quantity,maximum_quantity,review_due from v_site_inventory order by site,chemical

name: stocktake
title: Stocktake preparation
subtitle: Read-only snapshot. Record observed counts through the stock log.

sections.title: Containers
sections.sql: select code,chemical,site,location,quantity,unit,counted_on,state from v_containers where state<>'removed' order by site,location,code
